description: This file contains the implementation of MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations for the Broadcom B53 switch device. It includes register definitions, functions for reading and writing various data sizes through MDIO, switch driver probe and configuration routines, and driver registration.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_op(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 op)
methods.description: Performs an MDIO operation by setting the page and register address, and checking operation completion.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value from the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value to the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the specified MDIO page and register.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_read16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 * value)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit PHY register from a given address.

methods.name: int b53_mdio_phy_write16(struct b53_device * dev,int addr,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit PHY register at a given address.

methods.name: int b53_phy_probe(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Probes and initializes the B53 MDIO switch device and registers switch driver.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_init(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Initial configuration for the PHY device, setting default page and alias.

methods.name: void b53_phy_remove(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the switch device when PHY is detached.

methods.name: int b53_phy_config_aneg(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Negotiate auto-negotiation; here it does nothing and returns success.

methods.name: int b53_phy_read_status(struct phy_device * phydev)
methods.description: Reads the link status and speed from the device, and updates the PHY device state.

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id1
methods.description: PHY driver for BCM5325 and similar chips.

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id2
methods.description: PHY driver for BCM53125 and BCM53128.

methods.name: b53_phy_driver_id3
methods.description: PHY driver for BCM5365.

methods.description: unavailable
